Trigonometric Identities

Fundamental identities are: sin² θ + cos² θ = 1, 1 + tan² θ = sec² θ, and 1 + cot² θ = cosec² θ.

Compound Angle Formulas

Addition formulas: sin (α + β) = sin α × cos β + cos α × sin β, and cos (α + β) = cos α × cos β − sin α × sin β.

Trigonometric Quadrants

In the first quadrant (0° to 90°), all trigonometric functions are positive. In the second quadrant, only sin and cosec are positive.
